overview: Three focused changes refine responsive presentation, replace the timer tick sound, and add a personal principle.

groups.title: Responsive typography and spacing
groups.analysis: Page introductions become smaller on mobile, header gaps tighten below sm, and the footer uses a consistent text size. The article contents panel also reduces horizontal padding on small screens. These are presentation changes across shared components.

groups.title: A softer, pitched timer tick
groups.analysis: The clock tick replaces filtered random noise with a sine oscillator. Two alternating pitches, a short pitch drop, and a longer fading envelope create a plucked sound; urgent ticks use higher frequencies. This changes the sound generated by the timer rather than its scheduling rules.

groups.title: An additional personal principle
groups.analysis: The Words list on the then-existing More page gains “Eudaimonic > Hedonic”. This commit adds one statement to the personal notes. Later uncommitted home-page changes are outside this review.
